summary: The complete legal input domain contains only 100 initial values, so runtime scaling cannot provide a meaningful asymptotic verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer from 1 through 100

replacement_checks.evidence: For n greater than one, every value from n down to 2 is generated by x modulo (x - 1) equals 1, while 1 can never be generated; the answer is max(1, n - 1).
Regression checks all 100 legal inputs against an independent set-based simulation run until the board stabilizes.
